handoff.salientSummary: Fixed all 5 foh-core UI scrutiny findings. A failed floor-plan save now keeps the draft dirty, timers tick every 15 s, and the detail sheet pauses polling and keeps unsaved edits. English labels and aria-live text now go through Lingui with Arabic filled. Typecheck, related Vitest, lint, check-lingui and the setup and host-stand Playwright specs pass.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: (1) settings.floor-plan.tsx handleSave returns Promise<boolean> (true only when the save and refresh succeed). FloorPlanCanvas onSave is typed Promise<boolean> and calls setDirty(false) only when it returns true. 'Reload latest' now clears dirty explicitly so the fresh baseline applies, and Discard is unchanged. (2) useLiveNow uses intervalMs 15_000 in floor.tsx and use-host-stand.ts. pollIntervalMs is now today 5_000, calendar 60_000 and overview 60_000. (3) useHostStand pauses polling when Boolean(detailReservationId) (the ?r= param), which covers book, today, floor, timeline, calendar and overview. detail-sheet.tsx tracks dirty fields per field (table, lock, server, guestNotes, internalNotes, partySize, time, duration) in a ref set. syncFormFromReservation skips dirty fields. The set is cleared per field after a successful save or assign, and when the reservation id changes. loadDetail no longer depends on fallbackReservation, so each poll no longer refetches the detail. (4) Lingui MessageDescriptor tables via msg, rendered with _() or i18n._(): WEEKDAY_OPTIONS (now with a stable code used for test ids) and 'Every day', SHAPE_OPTIONS, canvas TABLE_SHAPES and ELEMENT_KINDS with their aria-labels, the availability-mode, special-day kind and block-reason badges, the section colour names and their aria-label, the floor and detail-sheet course options, the contact options, the booking-sheet occasion and dietary chips, and the covers label. All 10 timeline keyboard-DnD announcements use t``. Ran lingui:extract and filled 55 Arabic msgstr. (5) The e2e read-only test now waits for setup-general-form to be visible and the loading card to be gone. It also asserts the save button is disabled, replacing toHaveCount(0), which only passed before the form loaded.

discoveredIssues.description: settings.floor-plan.tsx handleSave returns false if the post-save refetch (fetchFloorPlan or refreshSummary) throws after the save itself succeeded. The draft then stays dirty, with the stale expectedFloorPlanVersion.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Return true as soon as saveFloorPlan resolves, and handle refetch errors separately.

discoveredIssues.description: Default section names in settings.sections.tsx ('Section A', 'Section B', 'Patio') and the default 'Main Dining' area name are English seed values that become stored data. I left them unwrapped.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Wrap them in Lingui if product wants localized defaults.
